name: Dynamic training dummies are viewed at the player's own level under world scaling (#12681)
contract: Report #12681: with world scaling on, a level 60 player saw the Stormwind dynamic training dummies at level 57.
npc_advanced_training_dummy idles at level 1 and only sets its real level to the attacker's (boss: +3) when
engaged, while Destiny Weaver shows every open-world creature at max(own, player - offset). An idle dummy was
therefore viewed below the player. The view of a dummy is now max(own, player level): a level 60 viewer sees
an idle Dynamic Training Dummy (967254) at 60. An ordinary level 1 creature next to it is the control and
still gets the normal offset view, below 60. Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1
and map 0 in DestinyWeaver.Scaling.WorldMaps; the scaling packet turns the player's own choice on.

steps.label: Let the login and choice refresh windows close
Let the dummy reset to its idle level
SETUP: the idle dummy's own level is 1
CONTROL: an ordinary level 1 creature is viewed with the offset, below the player
FIX: the idle dummy is viewed at the player's level
